description:
\begin{align*}
\max_{\boldsymbol y,t}\quad&t\\
\text{s.t.}\quad
&\sum_{\ell=1}^{199}(\mu_\ell+\sigma_\ell\zeta_\ell)y_\ell
+1.05y_{200}\ge t,\quad\forall\boldsymbol\zeta\in\mathcal U,\\
&\sum_{\ell=1}^{200}y_\ell=1,\qquad y_\ell\ge0,\\
&\mu_\ell=1.05+0.3\frac{200-\ell}{199},\quad
\sigma_\ell=0.05+0.6\frac{200-\ell}{199},\quad \ell=1,\ldots,199,\\
&\mathcal U=\{\boldsymbol\zeta\in\mathbb R^{199}:\|\boldsymbol\zeta\|_\infty\le1,\ \|\boldsymbol\zeta\|_1\le 45.921\}.
\end{align*}

\max_{\boldsymbol x,\boldsymbol y,\boldsymbol z}\quad&\sum_{j=1}^6P_jz_j\\
\text{s.t.}\quad
&\sum_{j=1}^6 C_j(1+0.5\xi_j)x_j+\sum_{j=1}^6V_jy_j\le400000,
\quad\forall\boldsymbol\xi\in\mathcal U,\\
&500+x_1-y_1-z_1=0,\\
&y_{j-1}+x_j-y_j-z_j=0,\quad j=2,\ldots,6,\\
&y_6=500,\quad 0\le x_j\le U_j,\quad0\le z_j\le D_j,\quad y_j\ge0,\\
&\boldsymbol P=(180,180,250,270,300,320),\\
&\boldsymbol C=(20,25,30,40,50,60),\quad\boldsymbol V=(2,2,2,2,2,2),\\
&\boldsymbol U=(1500,2000,2200,3000,2700,2500),\\
&\boldsymbol D=(1100,1500,1800,1600,2300,2500),\\
&\mathcal U=\{\boldsymbol\xi\in\mathbb R^6:\|\boldsymbol\xi\|_1\le2.6704\}.
\end{align*}
